speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. Can you tell me exactly when the swelling and pain in your right ring finger started, and have you experienced any recent trauma or insect bites to that area?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old male. The patient reports that the pain and swelling in his right ring finger began 2 days ago while playing football. He recalls his finger got caught in the jersey of another player, who then pulled away forcefully.

speaker: Doctor
text: Did you hear or feel a "pop" at the time of injury, and are you currently able to actively straighten the tip of your finger against resistance? I need to assess for a potential mallet finger or extensor tendon rupture.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Progressive swelling and pain in the right ring finger. I also have Inability to flex the right ring finger at the distal interphalangeal joint when making a fist, Pain at the distal interphalangeal joint, Extended right ring finger in resting position.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for clarifying the mechanics of the injury. To confirm the diagnosis, can you actively extend the tip of your right ring finger when I support the middle joint, or does it remain drooped? REQUEST TEST: X-ray right hand
